result.summary: Implemented the approved SAC-245 desktop reading queue and retained the completed implementation from the prior attempt. Claude’s review identified proof-only gaps; these are now addressed with hosted browser evidence showing the complete To read → Reading → Finished → To read cycle and count changes, a selected empty Finished filter with global counts preserved, and the saved Frank Herbert author visible after recovering from a rejected blank-author edit. Fresh checks passed: 31/31 tests, TypeScript compilation, production build, and static asset/no-network verification. The local preview returned HTTP 200. The immutable hosted preview was exercised at 1440×900 in five fresh-context scenarios; all 16 captures had HTTP 200 and no console errors, every image was inspected, and 13 images plus one Showboat record were selected for review. The collection also covers add, title validation, filtering, editing, author validation, deletion, refresh persistence, literal markup rendering, and long-text wrapping. All 23 OpenSpec tasks remain complete.
assumptions: The hosted preview is browser-local and desktop-only by approved scope; data does not synchronize across browsers or devices.
The hosted preview contains the same application assets as the fresh local build. Its registered tree predates only task-checkbox bookkeeping, not application code or built assets.
No new code repair was required in this continuation because Claude’s findings were limited to missing review captures.

classification: Four failed commands plus two failed relay calls masked by a later successful shell command, all already recorded. Original progress TimeoutError recorded separately. No further response command failure.
